about: Features on Chichester – Barnham – Ford – Arundel Jn – Arundel – Amberley, gathered for Milestone 2. Coordinates from OpenStreetMap (queried 2026-10-11, © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). approxKm is straight-line distance from Chichester station between consecutive features (real chainage is slightly longer on curves): good to ±0.2 km, NOT survey grade. Verify against the Network Rail Sectional Appendix, OpenRailwayMap and Ordnance Survey before trusting any of it.

junctions.name: Barnham Junction
junctions.what: Bognor Regis branch leaves at the west end of Barnham station, facing towards Ford. For an eastbound (Up) train from Chichester the points are TRAILING; a facing route to Bognor only exists for westbound (Down) trains, i.e. on the drive back.

junctions.name: Ford Junction
junctions.what: West curve to Littlehampton (Ford Junction – Littlehampton Junction) leaves the coast line here, just east of the River Arun bridge. Chichester – Amberley trains go STRAIGHT ON here.

junctions.name: Arundel Junction
junctions.what: THIS is where the Arun Valley line diverges north towards Arundel. OSM also marks Arundel Junction North and South nodes (the Littlehampton east curve and the line towards Angmering).

riverArun.name: Ford river bridge
riverArun.note: Between Ford station (and its level crossing) and Ford Junction. The line climbs to it on a visible gradient (Wikipedia, Ford station).

riverArun.name: Black Rabbit bridge
riverArun.note: Over the Arun just north of Arundel, near the Black Rabbit pub at Offham. Replaced August 2009 (Network Rail). Exact position not yet matched to an OSM bridge.

riverArun.name: Peppering bridge
riverArun.note: Over the Arun between Arundel and Amberley near Burpham/Peppering. Replaced August 2009 (Network Rail). Exact position not yet matched.

riverArun.name: OSM rail bridges Arundel – Amberley
riverArun.note: OSM marks main-line bridges at about lat 50.865, 50.869, 50.874, 50.875, 50.879 (tagged viaduct), 50.882, 50.883 and 50.885. Which of these span the river, side channels or roads needs checking on a map.

tunnels.name: North Stoke Tunnel
tunnels.note: 83 yd, between Arundel and Amberley (Wikipedia route diagram). Position not yet pinned down.

speedLimitsFromOsm.note: OSM maxspeed tags, NOT authoritative: the Sectional Appendix is.

engineersLineReferences.TBH: Three Bridges – Havant via Horsham. Covers Arun Valley line AND the coast line west of Arundel Jn through Ford, Barnham and Chichester (TBH1 Arun Valley, TBH2 Ford area per OSM).
engineersLineReferences.BLI: Brighton – Littlehampton: the coast line east of Arundel Jn towards Angmering.

notOnRoute: Lyminster (50.8253, -0.5425) and Toddington (50.8244, -0.5330) crossings are on the coast line EAST of Arundel Jn towards Angmering.
Brockham and Cragside 'stations' near Amberley are the Amberley Museum narrow-gauge railway, not Network Rail.
